title: Request envelope
description: The tracing fields every contract call carries. interface generates request_id; every layer that touches the request propagates it unchanged — that propagation is what makes C6 provenance reconstructable across five layers instead of five disconnected logs. No additionalProperties:false here, deliberately: this schema is composed via allOf into c6_provenance.schema.json, and additionalProperties:false on a subschema rejects the very fields the composing schema adds — a classic JSON Schema trap. The composing schema is where 'no extra fields' gets enforced, if it wants to.

request_id.description: Generated once, by the interface layer, at the start of a request. Never regenerated downstream.

emitted_at.description: When THIS record was produced, not when the request started.

emitted_by.description: Which layer produced this record. Not which layer the request is 'about'.
